calendar_source: Odisha Govt Gazette & Kohinoor / Radharamana Panji

festivals.name: Makar Sankranti
festivals.significance: Celebration of Uttarayana; preparation of Makara Chaula and rituals at Dhabaleswar.

festivals.name: Basanta Panchami / Veer Surendra Sai Jayanti
festivals.odia_name: ବସନ୍ତ ପଞ୍ଚମୀ / ବୀର ସୁରେନ୍ଦ୍ର ସାଏ ଜୟନ୍ତୀ
festivals.significance: Saraswati Puja, birth anniversary of Veer Surendra Sai, and ritual collection of wood for Ratha Yatra chariots.

festivals.name: Maha Shivaratri (Jagara)
festivals.significance: All-night fast and vigil culminating with the raising of the Mahadipa atop Lingaraj Temple.

festivals.name: Dola Purnima
festivals.significance: Swinging festival of Dola Govinda and Radha, reading of the new Odia Panji.

festivals.name: Holi (Dola Melana)
festivals.significance: Regional colors festival and village gathering of swing idols.

festivals.name: Utkal Divas (Odisha Day)
festivals.significance: Odisha state foundation day commemorating its linguistic formation in 1936.

festivals.name: Maha Bishuba Sankranti / Pana Sankranti
festivals.significance: Solar New Year, hanging of the Basudhara pot, and drinking of Bela Pana.

festivals.name: Akshaya Tritiya / Chandan Yatra Begins
festivals.significance: Akhi Muthi Anukula (ceremonial seed-sowing), Ratha construction start, and Narendra Tank boat festival.

festivals.name: Savitri Amavasya
festivals.significance: Strict marital fast observed by Odia women praying for their husbands' longevity.

festivals.name: Sitalsasthi Yatra
festivals.significance: Divine marriage of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, celebrated predominantly in Sambalpur.

festivals.name: Pahili Raja
festivals.significance: Opening day of the three-day festival celebrating earth's fertility, swing play, and Pitha.

festivals.name: Raja Sankranti
festivals.significance: Peak day of Raja Parba; agriculture completely pauses to let mother earth rest.

festivals.name: Devasnan Purnima (Snana Yatra)
festivals.significance: Ceremonial 108-pot bath of the Trinity on Snana Mandap; initiation of 15-day Anasara.

festivals.name: Puri Ratha Yatra (Sri Gundicha)
festivals.significance: World-famous Chariot Festival procession from Srimandir to Gundicha Temple.

festivals.name: Bahuda Yatra
festivals.significance: Return chariot journey of the deities back to the Singhadwara.

festivals.name: Suna Besha (Bada Tadhau Besha)
festivals.significance: Golden attire darshan of the Holy Trinity atop their chariots in Puri.

festivals.name: Gamha Purnima / Jhulan Purnima
festivals.significance: Balabhadra Janma, livestock worship, traditional gamha-jumping, and culmination of swing rituals.

festivals.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
festivals.significance: Worship of the Lord of Wisdom across academic institutions and clubs.

festivals.name: Nuakhai
festivals.significance: Western Odisha's premier harvest festival; Nabanna offering to Maa Samaleswari.

festivals.name: Mahalaya
festivals.significance: Tila Tarpan offerings to ancestors and formal invocation of Maa Durga.

festivals.name: Durga Puja (Maha Saptami)
festivals.significance: Beginning of full-scale public pandal worship of Goddess Durga in Cuttack and Bhubaneswar.

festivals.name: Dussehra / Vijaya Dashami
festivals.significance: Culmination of Sharadiya Durga Puja, Aparajita Puja, Astra Puja, and Ravan Podi.

festivals.name: Kumar Purnima / Gajalaxmi Puja Begins
festivals.significance: Moon worship (Chandra Puja) by unmarried youth; start of 11-day Dhenkanal Lakshmi Puja.

festivals.name: Diwali / Kali Puja / Bada Badua Daka
festivals.significance: Festival of lights; burning Kaunriya sticks in Puri to invite and guide ancestor spirits.

festivals.name: Anla Navami
festivals.significance: Worship of the Amla tree and sacred 'Radha Pada Darshan' at Sakshigopal Temple.

festivals.name: Rahas Purnima
festivals.significance: Culmination of Kartika month devotion and Raas Leela performances.

festivals.name: Kartika Purnima / Boita Bandana & Bali Jatra
festivals.significance: Floating of toy paper boats to commemorate Kalinga maritime voyages; launch of the Cuttack Bali Jatra.

festivals.name: Prathamastami
festivals.significance: Ceremony honoring the eldest child of the family with new attire and turmeric-leaf Enduri Pitha.
